process OPENMSTHIRDPARTY_PERCOLATORADAPTER {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/64/6475e53b3776cd3b71b8ff525f01da9c45dbe9401a00e5630d91ab976f20e8aa/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/openms-thirdparty:3.6.0--566f6f290d39203b'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(id_file)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.idXML"), emit: idxml
    tuple val(meta), path("*_feature_weights.tsv"), emit: feature_weights, optional: true
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('PercolatorAdapter'), eval("PercolatorAdapter --help 2>&1 | grep -oP '^Version: \\K[0-9.]+'"), emit: versions_percolatoradapter, topic: versions
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('percolator'), eval("percolator -h 2>&1 | grep -oP 'version \\K[0-9.]+'"), emit: versions_percolator, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}_percolator"
    if ("${id_file}" == "${prefix}.idXML") {
        error("Input and output names are the same, set prefix in module configuration to disambiguate!")
    }
    """
    PercolatorAdapter \\
        -in ${id_file} \\
        -out ${prefix}.idXML \\
        -threads ${task.cpus} \\
        ${args}
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}_percolator"
    if ("${id_file}" == "${prefix}.idXML") {
        error("Input and output names are the same, set prefix in module configuration to disambiguate!")
    }
    """
    echo ${args}

    touch ${prefix}.idXML
    touch ${prefix}_feature_weights.tsv
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/openmsthirdparty/percolatoradapter"
description: "Rescores peptide-spectrum matches with the semi-supervised learning\
  \ of Percolator and assigns q-values and posterior error probabilities."
keywords:
- "fdr"
- "idxml"
- "openms"
- "percolator"
- "proteomics"
- "rescoring"
tools:
- openms:
    description: "OpenMS is an open-source software C++ library for LC-MS data management\
      \ and analyses"
    homepage: "https://openms.de"
    documentation: "https://openms.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/OpenMS/OpenMS"
    doi: "10.1038/s41592-024-02197-7"
    licence:
    - "BSD"
    identifier: "biotools:openms"
- PercolatorAdapter:
    description: "Converts identifications to Percolator input, runs Percolator and\
      \ writes the rescored identifications."
    homepage: "https://openms.de"
    documentation: "https://openms.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/OpenMS/OpenMS"
    doi: "10.1038/s41592-024-02197-7"
    licence:
    - "BSD"
    identifier: ""
- percolator:
    description: "Semi-supervised learning for peptide identification from shotgun\
      \ proteomics datasets."
    homepage: "https://github.com/percolator/percolator"
    documentation: "https://github.com/percolator/percolator/wiki"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/percolator/percolator"
    doi: "10.1038/nmeth1113"
    licence:
    - "Apache-2.0"
    identifier: "biotools:percolator"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'test' ]`\n"
  - id_file:
      type: "file"
      description: "One or more files with peptide identifications and target/decoy\
        \ annotation, e.g. from a search engine.\nPercolatorAdapter merges multiple\
        \ files and rescores them together.\nAdd extra features with OpenMS PSMFeatureExtractor\
        \ before rescoring to improve the result.\n"
